title: Almond joy popped quinoa granola adds a taste of whimsy
description: I once marveled at turning 10. I remember looking back at the experiences of my life thus far and feeling that I had lived a long life already, and I was correct, in a way. At just 10 years old I had indeed experienced more than many of my peers and had learned things about the world that perhaps I shouldn’t have so young. I felt wise, but of course I was not, and would not learn that truth for many years. I saw my future self clearly then — professional, refined, accomplished, successful, and worldly. I had no doubts that I would get there — all I had to do was be a good student and get a college degree, and my life would be whatever I wanted it to be.
